summary: Frontend-only test of Batch 1 chat-reliability fixes (free@wladbot.test, 1920x800). Happy paths + failure paths (forced via Playwright page.route returning 500) all exercised. ChatPage: input clears on success, streaming bubble then final chat-ai-message render; on failure text restored, user bubble removed, chat-notice with backend detail + chat-retry-btn shown; retry succeeds. Drawer: send+stream works, input clears; failure restores text, removes bubble, shows message. Daily check-in: feedback in ~4s, input clears; failure keeps text + sonner toast, button re-enabled. Challengers: start (Bezos) + send + persona reply ~4s, input clears; failure keeps text, bubble removed, sonner toast. No freezes. Found 2 issues: (1) after a successful 'Erneut senden' retry, ChatPage input still holds the restored text (double-send risk); (2) WladHelp FAB covers the drawer send button.

ui_bugs.issue: The WladHelp support FAB (fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[140]) sits on top of the open drawer (z-[70]) and covers the drawer send button, so mouse clicks on the button do not get through (Playwright click timed out: 'wladhelp-fab subtree intercepts pointer events'). Pressing Enter still sends. Fix: hide WladHelp FAB while the drawer is open, or raise the drawer z-index above 140, or add right padding to the input row.

If a send fails, handleSend puts the text back in the input AND adds a notice with retryText. Clicking 'Erneut senden' calls handleSend(msg.retryText), so fromInput=false and setInput('') never runs on success. The input still shows 'Fehlertest Nachricht XYZ' after the retried message was answered, and the user can easily send it twice. Fix: clear the input on a successful retry if it still equals retryText, e.g. in applyResult: `setInput(prev => (fromInput || prev.trim() === text) ? '' : prev)`.

issues: The 'Support · Direktkontakt' feedback nudge card sits in the bottom-right and overlaps content and the sonner toasts (a toast rendered on top of the 'Feedback geben' button)
On the first dashboard visit, a full-screen onboarding tour (dashboard-first-tour, z-9999) blocks all clicks, including the FAB, until it is dismissed (this is expected, but tests need to handle it)

action_items: Stop the WladHelp FAB from covering the WladBot drawer send button (hide it while the drawer is open, or fix the z-index)
ChatPage: clear the input after a successful retry from the chat-notice 'Erneut senden' button when the input still contains the retried text

Optional: SSE edits during an in-flight send are wiped by setInput('') on success. The input stays editable while sending, so text typed in the meantime is lost. Consider clearing only if input === sent text
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPage.handleSend/applyResult: unconditional setInput('') on success discards anything the user typed while the reply streamed (the input is no longer cleared up-front). Same pattern in FloatingWladBotDrawer.send and ChallengersPage.sendMessage.
ChatPage retry path: fromInput=false for retries, so the restored input is never cleared (confirmed in UI).
FloatingWladBotDrawer error branch shows a plain assistant message with no retry button (inconsistent with ChatPage). Acceptable, since the input is restored.

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all 5 requested flows pass happy + failure paths; 1 overlay bug, 1 retry input-clear bug
